v1.target: actual wOBA in Y+1 (raw, pooled across seasons)
v1.note: legacy convention; the shipped gate verdicts were established here

v2.target: actual wOBA in Y+1 (within-OUTCOME-season z-score removes the era term)
v2.bootstrap: player-clustered (all of a player's pairs move together), season-stratified (players stratified by first predictor season); 2000 reps, seeded; CIs are wider by design
v2.note: transition-cycle companion; future gates must pre-declare v1 or v2

harness.pair_rule: Y->Y+1 pairs kept only when the OUTCOME season is complete (past Nov 15). Partial-year targets (e.g. mid-2026) are a defect, dropped under BOTH conventions.
harness.predictors: unrounded *_raw model scores (display rounding never enters evals)
interpretation_rules: existing VALIDATED ships STAND even if v2 weakens them; a reversal is flagged to the owner, not auto-reverted
ledgered NO-SHIPs are re-baselined under v2 but never revived by v2 alone
X-R2 / X-S2 flips are not promised

conventions.predictor: 0.7 * z(Savant est_woba) + 0.3 * z(unrounded HEM+ core hem_plus_raw), z-scored WITHIN the predictor season over the joined pair set
conventions.hem_core_source: cached StatsAPI hitting statlines scored via hem_plus (unrounded)
conventions.pair_set: the X-H3 pair set (Savant PA>=200 both years) with HEM core joined

gate.bar: blend forward-beats xwOBA-alone on the same pair set (paired bootstrap gap lo95 > 0, seed 20260706)

verdict.summary: Forward-chained OOS on the X-H3 pair set (1871 pairs): the 0.7/0.3 xwOBA+HEM-core blend predicts next-year wOBA at rho 0.4658 vs xwOBA-alone 0.4543 (HEM core alone 0.4147); paired bootstrap gap CI {'mean': 0.0114, 'lo95': 0.0038, 'hi95': 0.0197}. Shipped VALIDATED as the fwdhem_plus forward column: the light HEM leg recovers the shrunk-discipline signal xwOBA is blind to. The competing decayed-multiyear candidate (X-H4) failed its gate, so this single-season blend is the declared incumbent.

Forward-chained OOS over 7 year-pairs (1871 pairs): Savant xwOBA predicts next-year wOBA at rho 0.4543 vs actual wOBA 0.4108; bootstrap gap CI {'mean': 0.0432, 'lo95': 0.0173, 'hi95': 0.0699}. Shipped VALIDATED: xwOBA is the more forward-stable talent signal (it strips BABIP/sequencing luck), so xHEM+ (the HEM+ ratio scale on xwOBA) is a genuine deserved-offense companion. MLB-only + min-BBE gated, so it is a companion column, not population-complete.
